chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Al-Ḥusayn ibn Nuʿaym Al-Ṣaḥḥāf, who said:

I, and Hishām ibn Al-Ḥakam, and ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn were in Baghdad. Then ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn said: I was seated in the presence of Al-ʿAbd Al-Ṣāliḥ, when his son ʿAlī entered upon him. So he said to me: O ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, this is ʿAlī, the chief of my children. Indeed, I have bestowed upon him my teknonym. So Hishām ibn Al-Ḥakam struck his forehead with the palm of his hand, then said: Woe to you, how did you say it? Then ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn said: By Allah, I heard it from him exactly as I have said. So Hishām said: He informed you that the command is in him after him.

Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Al-Ḥusayn ibn Nuʿaym Al-Ṣaḥḥāf, who said: I was in the presence of Al-ʿAbd Al-Ṣāliḥ. And in the copy of Al-Ṣafwānī, he said: I was, then he mentioned the like of it.

key_terms.الْأَمْرَ: The authority or leadership, referring here to the Imamate
key_terms.الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ: A title used here for Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام
key_terms.سَيِّدُ وُلْدِي: The foremost and most eminent among my children
key_terms.نَحَلْتُهُ: I bestowed or granted to him

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith indicate the Imamate of Imam ʿAlī al-Riḍā عليه السلام after Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an indication from Al-ʿAbd Al-Ṣāliḥ عليه السلام concerning the status of his son ʿAlī عليه السلام, describing him as the chief of his children and granting him his teknonym. In Shia context, the narration is significant as evidence pointing to the succession and authority of Imam Al-Riḍā عليه السلام after his father عليه السلام.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Husayn Bin Nuaym Al Sahhaf who said,

‘I, and Hisham Bin Al-Hakam, and Ali Bin Yaqteen were at Baghdad, so Ali Bin Yaqteen said, ‘I was seated in the presence of Abd Al-Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>), and his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> came over to him<sup>asws</sup>. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘O Ali Bin Yaqteen! This Ali<sup>asws</sup>, is the chief of my<sup>asws</sup> children. As for I<sup>asws</sup>, I<sup>asws</sup> have gifted him<sup>asws</sup> my<sup>asws</sup> teknonym’. So Hisham Bin Al-Hakam touched his forehead by his palm, then said, ‘Woe be unto you! How?’ I said, ‘Ali Bin Yaqteen said he heard it, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, from him<sup>asws</sup> just as he said’. So Hisham said, ‘Did he inform you that the command (Imamate) is in him<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>asws</sup>?’

Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Al-Husayn Bin Nuaym Al-Sahhaf who said, ‘I was in the presence of Al-Abd Al-Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>)’. And in a copy of Al-Safwany, he said, ‘I was’, then mentioned similar to it.
en.sarwar: Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from al-Husayn ibn Nu‘aym al-Sahhaf who has said the following. “Once I was in the presence of the pious servant (of Allah).In al-Safwani manuscript it says, “I was then he relates the rest of the above hadith.”
